grading_method.binary_expectations: graded from the retained final answer and transcript, with independent destination checks kept separate from run-trace evidence
grading_method.semantic_quality: not blindly scored; the maintainer had already seen arm identities before grading

expectations.text: [CRITICAL] The final response contains the formulated definition in section 3 and uses the five required numbered top-level sections in order without conversational filler.
expectations.evidence: final.md contains the five required numbered top-level sections in order. Section 3 contains only the formulated definition, and the retained final answer has no preamble or closing conversation.

expectations.text: The transcript shows established vocabulary research before the final definition is settled.
expectations.evidence: Before item_4's final answer, transcript items 1-3 search W3C DCAT Dataset terminology, target the Dataset deep link, and check the candidate definition text.

expectations.text: The retained trace contains a completed URL-specific retrieval action for the authoritative W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary Dataset entry rather than only a search-result excerpt or vocabulary homepage.
expectations.evidence: Completed transcript item_2 names the exact destination https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Dataset. It is a completed non-error URL-specific event before the final answer.

expectations.text: The reuse section identifies Path A, B, or C and explains that choice from the definitions actually found instead of assuming reuse from the prompt.
expectations.evidence: Section 2 selects Path A and explains that the W3C definition matches both extension and intension and already satisfies the mandatory definition requirements.

expectations.text: The definition classifies Dataset as a collection of data or an equally immediate superordinate concept.
expectations.evidence: Section 3 begins 'A collection of data', and section 1 independently identifies the genus as Collection of data.

expectations.text: The differentia preserve the conceptual dataset and do not conflate it with a distribution, downloadable file, serialization, metadata record, or API response.
expectations.evidence: The definition keeps the Dataset as the collection and says it is available in one or more representations. Sections 1 and 4 explicitly distinguish distributions, files, serializations, data services, service responses, and catalog records.

expectations.text: The final definition is singular, positive, standalone, non-circular, concise, and free of uncommon abbreviations and embedded definitions.
expectations.evidence: The one-sentence noun phrase positively defines one collection, does not repeat Dataset as its own genus, contains no abbreviations, and does not define constituent terms.

expectations.text: The compliance audit evaluates each of the five mandatory ISO/IEC 11179-4 requirements explicitly rather than reporting an unsupported blanket pass.
expectations.evidence: Section 4 separately evaluates singularity, positive declaration, descriptive form, abbreviations, and embedded definitions, with a reason for each result.

expectations.text: [CRITICAL] Repositories Queried is present and non-empty, and every named repository corresponds to a visible pre-answer search or completed URL-specific retrieval action in the retained trace.
expectations.evidence: Repositories Queried names only the W3C Data Catalog Vocabulary. Transcript item_1 visibly searches that repository and item_2 names its exact Dataset destination.

expectations.text: [CRITICAL] The retained trace contains a completed URL-specific retrieval action for every URL kept in Verified Sources; a topical search, site-restricted search, search-result excerpt, or generic homepage does not count for a deeper destination.
expectations.evidence: Verified Sources contains the Dataset and Distribution deep links. The trace names the Dataset link in completed item_2 but never names https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution in a completed event. The answer's claim that exact-URL retrieval completed for both links is therefore unsupported by the retained trace.

expectations.text: [CRITICAL] Verified Sources is present and non-empty, and an independent grader can open every listed URL to accessible source content rather than a search result, generic homepage, authentication wall, or error page.
expectations.evidence: Verified Sources lists two W3C specification anchors. Independent checks opened both anchors to accessible DCAT 3 specification content.

expectations.text: [CRITICAL] Each independently opened destination supports the exact semantic role attributed to it; evidence for a constituent concept or a rejected attribution is not presented as an exact definition of the compound designation.
expectations.evidence: The Dataset anchor supplies the exact reused definition and conceptual-dataset usage note. The Distribution anchor defines a distribution as a specific representation and supports the stated boundary role.

source_verification.trace_schema_limitation: Codex JSONL exposes completed web events but may omit response bodies and HTTP status. Only completed events that visibly name an exact URL count for the trace layer.

destinations.evidence: The DCAT 3 Dataset entry defines a collection of data published or curated by a single agent and available in one or more representations, and identifies the conceptual dataset.
The DCAT 3 Distribution entry defines a specific representation of a dataset and discusses access by download, service, or web page.

semantic_quality.reason: The protocol requires arm labels to be removed before a human scores the five dimensions. No independent blinded human grade was available, and a non-blind score is not substituted.
